messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Randomized search with simulated annealing and local coordinate perturbations seeded from known best solutions

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A simulated annealing search seeded from the known optimal Heilbronn configuration for n=12 and inserting a 13th point at the centroid of the largest-area Delaunay triangle will converge to a configuration with minimum triangle area strictly exceeding 0.0025, because the optimal n=13 arrangement is a local perturbation of the n=12 triangular lattice with one interstitial point rather than a globally distinct packing."}
